answers.core: Unbinding and binding arguments when connecting signals in the editor is already core, this proposal is to allow doing both at the same time in the editor, a feature the engine already supports in code.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around with a few lines of code - but those lines are often unique to the signal you need to replace arguments on and, in my case, require me to add a custom script to an object that is otherwise completely composed of generic code.

title: Allow connecting signals with both unbound and bound arguments in the editor
